newsitem.title: USA: USDA offers Guatemala $10 mln under SCGP program.
newsitem.headline: USDA offers Guatemala $10 mln under SCGP program.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Friday authorized $10 million in credit gurantees for sales of U.S. farm goods to Guatemala under the Supplier Credit Guarantee Program (SCGP) in fiscal year 1997 .
USDA said the commodities covered include fresh fruit, potatoes and meat.
The program is a new adaption of the Export Credit Guarantee Program (GSM-102) designed to assist exporters who wish to provide relatively short-term credits to their importers.
